That code is NOT under the GPL. SyndicatFX's COPYING says it distributes it without charge, in good faith, for owners of the original game, and will take it down should the copyright holders complain; this package carries it the same way, translated to C. The package carries none of Syndicate's data files: the game's original files are the project's firmware, supplied by the user. The menu texts it embeds are SyndicatFX's own translation files (lang/*.po).
